frame: local east-north: up = north (away from the south pole), right = east; row 0 = north edge, col 0 = west edge
contour_note: metres relative to the site, every 25 m, from LOLA 20 m DEM smoothed
made_with: Derived from NASA LOLA data by scripts written with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, Anthropic) for the Long Shadows project, NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

light.note: percent of 2027 with at least part of the Sun's disc above the skyline (mean visible fraction), 10 m above ground, 80 m cells, row 0 = north edge
